pmid-30263892.summary_ja: 更年期11年後に診断された子宮絨毛癌の稀な症例。子宮内腫瘤によるpostmenopausal bleedingで発症し、血清hCG上昇を認めた。多剤化学療法により管理。妊娠と無関連の絨毛疾患の発症可能性を提示。
pmid-30263892.summary_en: Rare case of uterine choriocarcinoma presenting 11 years after menopause with postmenopausal bleeding in 62-year-old woman. Diagnosed by endometrial biopsy with positive hCG staining and elevated serum β-hCG; treated with multidrug chemotherapy following FIGO guidelines with good outcome.

pmid-30263965.summary_ja: 後腹膜性性腺外セミノーマに乳び漏を合併した症例。漏出部位の同定にメチレンブルーのリンパ節内注入を用いた腹腔鏡手術を施行した。乳び排出は消失し、保存的治療に抵抗性の乳び漏に対して低侵襲アプローチが有効であることが示された。
pmid-30263965.summary_en: Case of retroperitoneal extragonadal seminoma complicated by chylous leakage treated with laparoscopic surgery using methylene blue lymph node injection for leak localization. Successful resolution of chyle output demonstrates feasibility of minimally invasive approach for conservative-resistant chylous leakage.

pmid-30275993.summary_ja: 卵子採取中に卵巣成熟奇形腫が破裂した症例。腹膜刺激症状が約3週間後に重篤な化学的腹膜炎に進行し、敗血症性ショックを伴った。腹腔鏡検査で破裂奇形腫が確認され、手術治療後に改善。
pmid-30275993.summary_en: Case report of ruptured ovarian mature teratoma during transvaginal oocyte retrieval causing chemical peritonitis, pleuritis, and septic shock. Initial nonspecific symptoms progressed to severe peritonitis with septic shock three weeks post-procedure, managed surgically with successful recovery.

pmid-30281013.summary_ja: 未治療暗黙化精巣から発生した成熟奇形腫混在の原始神経外胚葉腫瘍の症例。化学療法と外科治療を施行されたが、患者の非協力により治療遅延と最悪の転帰をもたらした。
pmid-30281013.summary_en: Rare case report of primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) mixed with mature teratoma arising from untreated cryptorchid testis in 26-year-old male with schizophrenia. Despite multidisciplinary treatment with chemotherapy and surgery, patient non-compliance led to suboptimal outcome and death.

pmid-30285559.summary_ja: 化学療法後にFDG-PET陽性の残存病変を有する転移性セミノーマ患者90例の国際レジストリ研究。生存腫瘍に対するFDG-PETのPPVは23%と低く、切除標本の81%は壊死を示した。PET陽性のみに基づく臨床判断は慎重であるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-30285559.summary_en: International registry study of 90 patients with metastatic seminoma with FDG-PET-positive residual lesions after chemotherapy. FDG-PET had low positive predictive value (23%) for vital tumor; 81% of resected specimens showed necrosis. Study cautions against clinical decisions based solely on PET positivity.

pmid-30287918.summary_ja: 小児生殖細胞腫瘍154例のエピゲノム解析。ジェルミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、混合型による差別化されたDNAメチル化パターンを同定。腫瘍組織型による明確なエピジェネティック違いが示された。
pmid-30287918.summary_en: Epigenome-wide study of DNA methylation patterns in 154 pediatric GCTs across histologic subtypes (germinomas, yolk sac tumors, teratomas, mixed histology). Four distinct methylation clusters closely corresponded to tumor histology; germinomas showed lower methylation with distinct angiogenesis and immune pathway signatures.

pmid-30288014.summary_ja: 16歳女児に発生した巨大後腹膜奇形腫の症例。12×10cmの石灰化囊胞性腫瘤が腹部左側を占拠。外科的切除で治療された稀な小児症例。
pmid-30288014.summary_en: Case report of giant retroperitoneal teratoma in 16-year-old girl presenting with large (12×10 cm) calcified cystic mass occupying left abdomen. Tumor successfully treated by surgical excision, representing rare presentation of retroperitoneal GCT in pediatric patient.

pmid-30294341.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の細胞株（TCam-2およびNT2/D1）において、PIWI-LIKE 2発現のDNAメチル化による制御を検討した研究。TCam-2細胞はプロモーターが高メチル化されて発現が低く、NT2/D1細胞は低メチル化で発現が高かった。脱メチル化処理によりTCam-2細胞で発現が増加した。
pmid-30294341.summary_en: Study of DNA methylation regulation of PIWI-LIKE 2 expression in germ cell tumor cell lines (TCam-2 and NT2/D1). TCam-2 cells showed high promoter methylation with lower PIWI-LIKE 2 expression, while NT2/D1 cells showed hypomethylation and higher expression. Demethylation increased expression in TCam-2 cells.

pmid-30295666.summary_ja: 胎盤由来コンドロイチン硫酸A(plCSA)を標的とした脂質ポリマーナノ粒子(plCSA-DNPs)の合成と特性化。ドキソルビシン搭載ナノ粒子は絨毛癌細胞への効率的薬物送達を実現。
pmid-30295666.summary_en: Development of placental chondroitin sulfate A-targeting lipid-polymer nanoparticles (plCSA-DNPs) for targeted drug delivery. Doxorubicin-loaded nanoparticles efficiently delivered drug to placental choriocarcinoma (JEG3) cells expressing plCSA, demonstrating potential targeted cancer therapy approach.

pmid-30302276.summary_ja: F9胚胎がん細胞の代謝プロファイルと胚外内胚葉への分化能を検討。細胞継代数により代謝プロファイルが変化するが分化能は保持。ゲノム完全性の変化と代謝プロファイルの関連性を示唆。
pmid-30302276.summary_en: Study examining metabolic profiles of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells during differentiation to extraembryonic endoderm. Early and late passage cells showed different metabolic preferences (glycolysis vs. oxidative phosphorylation) but maintained similar differentiation potential, suggesting passage number impacts metabolism more than differentiation capacity.

pmid-30302364.summary_ja: 難治性高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌の症例。7種類の化学療法と複数の救済手術を施行され、4年間hCG低値を維持後に肺転移出現。外科的救済で最終的に管理された。
pmid-30302364.summary_en: Case report of high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma with refractory disease requiring seven chemotherapy lines and multiple salvage surgeries. Patient achieved persistently low hCG for 4 years before pulmonary metastases appeared, ultimately managed with surgical salvage, illustrating management of chemotherapy-resistant gestational GTN.

pmid-30303159.summary_ja: 妊娠33週の21歳妊婦に発生した子宮原発ディスジャーミノーマの稀な症例。骨盤底に広がる大腫瘍に対し手術施行、組織学的・免疫組織化学的に診断確定。性腺外生殖細胞腫瘍の重要な症例。
pmid-30303159.summary_en: Case report of primary dysgerminoma arising in the uterus of 21-year-old pregnant woman at 33 weeks gestation. Patient underwent surgery for large mass extending to pelvic floor, with histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirming rare diagnosis of primary intrauterine dysgerminoma.

pmid-30306586.summary_ja: 妊娠滋養膜疾患(GTD)の診断と治療に関する最新レビュー。胞状奇胎から絨毛膜癌への進行、hCG監視、リスク分類に基づいた化学療法戦略を詳説。低リスク疾患は化学療法で完全治癒、高リスク疾患で約90%の生存率。
pmid-30306586.summary_en: Comprehensive review of gestational trophoblastic disease including epidemiology, diagnosis, and management of hydatidiform mole and gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Low-risk disease achieves 100% survival with single-agent chemotherapy; high-risk disease requires multiagent chemotherapy with approximately 90% survival rate.

pmid-30310049.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に随伴した重症抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例。免疫療法と両側卵管卵巣摘出術にもかかわらず難治性自律神経障害を発症し、永久ペースメーカー植込みが必要となった稀な重症例。
pmid-30310049.summary_en: Case report of severe anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma in a 21-year-old female. Despite immunotherapy and bilateral salpingoophorectomy, patient developed refractory autonomic dysfunction requiring permanent cardiac pacemaker, highlighting severe complications possible in this syndrome.

pmid-30311543.summary_ja: 絨毛癌におけるAhRのがん幹細胞特性制御における役割を検証。AhR活性化は球形成能と化学療法抵抗性を増加させ、AhR阻害は減少させた。AhRが絨毛癌の新規治療標的となる可能性を示唆。
pmid-30311543.summary_en: Study investigating aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) role in regulating cancer stem cell-like characteristics in choriocarcinoma. AhR activation increased spheroid formation and chemotherapy resistance, while AhR knockdown reduced these properties, suggesting AhR as a novel therapeutic target for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-30317718.summary_ja: 化学療法後に残存腫瘍と胸骨柄を一塊切除・再建した縦隔セミノーマの症例。胸壁浸潤を伴う稀な症例で、多学際的な外科的アプローチと基準センターでの治療の重要性を示している。
pmid-30317718.summary_en: Case report of 30-year-old male with primary mediastinal seminoma treated with chemotherapy followed by en bloc resection of residual tumor and manubrium reconstruction. Demonstrates complex surgical management of residual mediastinal GCT with chest wall involvement, emphasizing need for multidisciplinary approach in referral centers.

pmid-30321995.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍再発患者の血清miR-371a-3pレベルが、寛解中患者と比較して有意に上昇し、従来の腫瘍マーカーよりも感度が高い可能性を示唆。幹細胞関連微小RNAが再発検出の新規バイオマーカーとなり得ることを示した。
pmid-30321995.summary_en: Study of miR-371a-3p as a serum biomarker for detecting disease recurrence in testicular germ cell tumor patients. Serum miR-371a-3p levels were 13.65-fold higher in patients with proven recurrence compared to disease-free patients, suggesting superior sensitivity to traditional tumor markers (hCG, AFP, LDH) for monitoring TGCT recurrence.

pmid-30323365.summary_ja: 若年女性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に生じたGrowing teratoma syndrome（GTS）の2症例報告。化学療法中・後に腫瘍サイズが増大し腫瘍マーカーは正常化、切除検体では成熟奇形腫の組織像を示した。治療の基本は外科的切除であり、再発や化学療法抵抗性との鑑別が課題である。
pmid-30323365.summary_en: Two case reports of growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in ovarian germ cell tumors in young women. GTS characterized by tumor size increase during/after chemotherapy with normalized tumor markers and mature teratoma histology on resection. Surgical excision is mainstay of treatment; diagnosis challenging to distinguish from recurrence or chemo-resistance.

pmid-30323687.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形種に関連する重篤な免疫血小板減少症の症例。奇形種摘出後に完全寛解。文献報告2例目。奇形種由来ペプチド分泌または遺伝的素因による傍腫瘍症候群の可能性を示唆。
pmid-30323687.summary_en: Case report of severe immune thrombocytopenia associated with ovarian cystic teratoma. Thrombocytopenia completely resolved following surgical excision of the teratoma. This is only the second reported case of this association, suggesting possible paraneoplastic mechanism related to peptide secretion or genetic predisposition.

pmid-30324039.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性GCT中で最も稀な純粋絨毛癌の症例。皮膚、消化管、脳への広範な転移を示す。純粋精巣絨毛癌は極めて悪性度が高く、早期に広範な転移を伴う。
pmid-30324039.summary_en: Case report of pure testicular choriocarcinoma, the rarest non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, with extensive metastases to skin, gastrointestinal tract, and brain. Pure testicular choriocarcinoma is extremely aggressive with early and extensive metastatic spread, presenting unique treatment challenges.

pmid-30324570.summary_ja: 14歳以下の小児精巣腫瘍67例の臨床・病理学的特性検討。診断時中央年齢18ヶ月、73.1%が3歳未満。奇形種(47.8%)と卵黄嚢腫瘍(29.9%)が主体。55.2%が根治的摘除、44.8%が精巣温存術。適切な治療で再発なし。
pmid-30324570.summary_en: Retrospective review of 67 prepubertal testicular tumors (median age 18 months; 73.1% diagnosed before age 3). Most common histology was teratoma (47.8%), followed by yolk sac tumor (29.9%). 55.2% underwent radical orchiectomy; 44.8% had testis-sparing surgery. No recurrence or testicular atrophy with appropriate treatment.

pmid-30324783.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者57例の精子形成程度と同側生殖能(IF)を検討。49%にIF存在、完全精子形成57.8%、精巣上体成熟精子82.7%。腫瘍サイズとIFの相関なし。術前精子保存の重要性を示唆。
pmid-30324783.summary_en: Retrospective study of 57 testicular GCT patients examining spermatogenesis extent and ipsilateral fertility (IF). IF present in 49% of patients; full spermatogenesis observed in 57.8%, mature epididymal sperm in 82.7%. No correlation between maximum tumor diameter and ipsilateral fertility; routine pre-orchiectomy sperm banking recommended.

pmid-30335019.summary_ja: 妊娠関連絨毛癌の脳転移を伴う症例(Stage IV)。5-FU+アクチノマイシンD化学療法と全脳放射線療法で完全寛解達成。17ヶ月無再発生存。早期診断と層別化治療による予後改善を示唆。
pmid-30335019.summary_en: Case report of 32-year-old woman with postpartum choriocarcinoma presenting with stage IV disease (risk score 16) with brain metastases. Treated with multidrug chemotherapy (5-fluorouracil + actinomycin D) and whole brain radiotherapy, achieving complete remission with 17-month disease-free survival, demonstrating importance of timely diagnosis and stratified treatment.

pmid-30340650.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者31例と対照61例の精子92検体を対象に、インプリント遺伝子のDNAメチル化を検討。正常な精子形成を有するセミノーマ患者では精子インプリンティングは保たれていたが、乏精子症の対照群では有意な異常が認められた。精巣胚細胞腫瘍と不妊症に共通のインプリンティング異常が関与する可能性は低いと示唆している。
pmid-30340650.summary_en: Study of 92 sperm samples from 31 seminoma patients and 61 controls examining DNA methylation at imprinted gene regions. Seminoma patients with normal spermatogenesis showed intact sperm imprinting, while oligozoospermic controls showed significant defects. Suggests low involvement of common imprinting defects in both testicular GCT and subfertility.

pmid-30340968.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形種関連のNMDAR抗体陽性眼振間代クローヌス症候群の症例。奇形種摘出と免疫療法で3ヶ月で完全回復。NMDAR抗体が眼振間代クローヌス症候群の直接原因ではないことを示唆。
pmid-30340968.summary_en: Case report of young woman with NMDAR antibody-positive, teratoma-related isolated opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome without encephalopathy. Removal of ovarian teratoma combined with immunotherapy (steroids, IVIg, plasma exchange, rituximab) resulted in complete recovery after 3 months, suggesting NMDAR-ab is not the primary cause of OMS.

pmid-30346857.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形種患者27例の長期予後検討。慢性便秘(25.9%)、便失禁(3.7%)、排尿動態異常(66%)を認めた。87.5%が抗コリン薬治療、25.9%が間欠自己導尿が必要。
pmid-30346857.summary_en: Retrospective study of 27 sacrococcygeal teratoma patients with available urodynamic data. Late effects included chronic constipation (25.9%), fecal incontinence (3.7%), and urodynamic abnormalities (66%). Anticholinergic treatment used in 87.5% with abnormalities; clean intermittent catheterization needed in 25.9%.

pmid-30349318.summary_ja: 未熟奇形種、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胚細胞癌から構成される悪性混合卵巣GCT患者。EGFR p.L858R変異を有し、標的治療と救済手術を施行。化学療法耐性MOGCTにおける遺伝子検査と救済手術の重要性を示唆。
pmid-30349318.summary_en: Case report of 34-year-old woman with refractory mixed malignant ovarian germ cell tumor (immature teratoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma) harboring EGFR p.L858R mutation. Treatment included targeted therapy, salvage surgery, and continued chemotherapy, highlighting importance of genetic testing and salvage surgery in platinum-resistant MOGCT.

pmid-30358221.summary_ja: 精巣GCT 104例のN-カドヘリン発現を免疫組織化学で検討。セミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍で陽性、胚細胞癌と奇形種で陰性。転移GCTにおけるセミノーマと胚細胞癌の鑑別に有用。
pmid-30358221.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of N-cadherin expression in 104 primary and metastatic testicular GCT cases. N-cadherin positive in seminomas and yolk sac tumors but negative in embryonal/chorionic carcinomas and teratomas. N-cadherin may help differentiate seminomas from embryonal carcinomas in metastatic GCT.

pmid-30358706.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化155例(扁平上皮癌90例、58%;非SCC 65例、42%)を対象としたシステマティックレビュー。SCC群と非SCC群で臨床的特徴および全生存期間は類似していた。平均年齢は約50歳で、病理型は多様であり、一部に予後の差が示唆された。
pmid-30358706.summary_en: Systematic review of 155 cases of malignant transformation in mature cystic teratoma (MCT): 90 squamous cell carcinomas (58%) and 65 non-SCC cases (42%). Clinical characteristics and overall survival were similar between SCC and non-SCC groups. Mean patient age approximately 50 years with varied pathological types showing some prognostic differences.

pmid-30367327.summary_ja: 放射線療法と化学療法に抵抗性を示す胚細胞腫瘍の一型としての精巣奇形腫についての総説である。化学療法後の奇形腫様腫瘤の切除を中心とした外科的管理を強調し、増大する奇形腫症候群と体細胞型への悪性転化を取り上げる。治療成績の向上には、大規模施設での管理が不可欠であると述べている。
pmid-30367327.summary_en: Review of testicular teratomas as GCT entities resistant to radio- and chemotherapy. Emphasizes surgical management, particularly post-chemotherapy resection of teratomatous masses, growing teratoma syndrome, and somatic-type transformation. Management in high-volume centers is essential for improved outcomes.

pmid-30367648.summary_ja: 臨床病期1の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者75例を後方視的に解析し、12例が神経温存RPLNDを受けた。5例にリンパ節転移があり、全例が無病生存を維持し、順行性射精も温存された。化学療法の併存禁忌や画像所見が不確定な奇形腫成分の多い症例など、適切に選択された患者にはRPLNDが有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-30367648.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 75 clinical stage 1 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients, with 12 undergoing nerve-sparing RPLND. Five patients had lymph node metastases; all remained disease-free with preserved antegrade ejaculation. RPLND remains valuable for selected patients with chemotherapy contraindications or high teratoma content with equivocal imaging.

pmid-30386097.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫が原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍へ悪性転化した症例の報告。病勢進行リスクが高いまれな合併症であり、外科的切除と化学療法により治療されたことが述べられている。
pmid-30386097.summary_en: Case presentation of malignant transformation of testicular teratoma into primitive neuroectodermal tumor, a rare complication characterized by high risk of disease progression, managed with surgical resection and chemotherapy.

pmid-30386651.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘤が疑われた小型病変の12例を後方視的に検討し、セミノーマ2例と思春期前型奇形腫1例を含む。凍結切片評価は良悪性の鑑別において83%の正診率を示した。
pmid-30386651.summary_en: Retrospective review of 12 patients with small testicular masses managed by frozen section assessment, including 2 seminomas and 1 pre-pubertal teratoma, demonstrating 83% accuracy of frozen section for distinguishing benign from malignant lesions.

pmid-30386652.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化と精巣胚細胞腫瘍・男性不妊症との関連を検討した総説。危険因子が併存する場合にのみ経過観察が推奨されると結論づけている。
pmid-30386652.summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular microlithiasis analyzing its association with testicular germ cell tumors and male infertility, concluding that follow-up is recommended only in presence of additional risk factors for testicular cancer.

pmid-30389739.summary_ja: 生後5か月の乳児に発生した前縦隔奇形腫の周術期管理の症例報告。大きな縦隔腫瘤を伴う場合の麻酔導入と気道管理の困難さを記述している。
pmid-30389739.summary_en: Case report of perioperative management of anterior mediastinal teratoma in 5-month-old infant, describing challenges of anesthetic induction and airway management with large mediastinal masses.

pmid-30390643.summary_ja: 精巣GCT 247例におけるβ-カテニン発現を検討し、非セミノーマで発現が高く、中間/高リスク疾患、縦隔部位、および免疫浸潤抑制と関連することを示した。
pmid-30390643.summary_en: Study of β-catenin expression in 247 testicular germ cell tumor specimens, finding higher expression in non-seminomas associated with intermediate/poor risk disease, mediastinal location, and suppressed immune infiltration.

pmid-30396168.summary_ja: 絨毛膜がんにおけるSFRP2発現とWnt/β-カテニンシグナルを検討し、プロモーター脱メチル化による発現増加が細胞移動・侵襲を抑制することを示した。
pmid-30396168.summary_en: Investigates SFRP2 expression and function in choriocarcinoma, demonstrating that increased SFRP2 through promoter demethylation inhibits cell migration and invasion via suppression of Wnt/β-catenin signaling and epithelial-mesenchymal transition.

pmid-30397434.summary_ja: 若年女性に発生した肝成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、カルチノイド腫瘍への悪性転化を伴う稀な症例。広範な画像検査および内視鏡検査の後、腹腔鏡手術で切除された。
pmid-30397434.summary_en: Rare case of hepatic mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation to carcinoid tumor in a young female, treated by laparoscopic resection after extensive imaging and endoscopic workup.

pmid-30400387.summary_ja: 細菌由来プロディギオシンの絨毛膜がん細胞株JEG3に対する抗がん作用メカニズムを検討し、カスパーゼ経路を介したアポトーシス誘導とIAP族タンパク質抑制を示した。
pmid-30400387.summary_en: Investigates anticancer mechanisms of bacterial prodigiosin against human choriocarcinoma cell line JEG3, demonstrating apoptosis induction through caspase-mediated pathways and suppression of IAP family proteins with in vivo efficacy in tumor-bearing mice.

pmid-30402313.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞がんが脊髄圧迫症候群で初発した24歳男性症例で、若年男性の脊髄圧迫の鑑別診断においてGCTを考慮する必要性を強調。
pmid-30402313.summary_en: 24-year-old male with embryonal carcinoma presenting with malignant spinal cord compression from retroperitoneal metastatic disease, highlighting the importance of considering GCT as a cause of cord compression in young men.

pmid-30402315.summary_ja: 精巣混合性種細胞腫瘍において、成熟および未熟テラトーマ成分からPNETおよび骨肉腫への悪性化を認めた18歳男性症例で、化学療法により完全奏効を得た。
pmid-30402315.summary_en: 18-year-old with metastatic testicular mixed germ cell tumor containing mature and immature teratoma components undergoing malignant transformation to PNET in primary tumor and osteosarcoma in pulmonary metastasis, achieving complete remission with combination chemotherapy.

pmid-30405925.summary_ja: 30歳女性の卵巣副尿管嚢胞の絡み合いによる急性腹症の症例報告であり、卵巣成熟嚢胞性テラトーマの偶発的発見を含む。
pmid-30405925.summary_en: Case report of acute abdomen in a 30-year-old woman caused by entangled paratubal cysts, with incidental finding of mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary, both managed by laparoscopic excision.

pmid-30410393.summary_ja: 精巣外絨毛膜がん197症例の人口ベース研究で、診断時中央年齢30歳、最多部位は縦隔および後腹膜、5年生存率35%であり、若年および脳部位が良好な予後因子として同定された。
pmid-30410393.summary_en: Population-based study analyzing 197 cases of extragonadal choriocarcinoma in males, reporting median age of 30 years with most common sites being mediastinum and retroperitoneum, and 5-year survival rate of 35% with younger age and brain location as favorable prognostic factors.

pmid-30410697.summary_ja: 若年女性にみられた卵巣絨毛癌の空腸転移による大量消化管出血の症例報告。内視鏡検査で結論が得られなかった後、CT血管造影で出血部位を特定した。空腸切除と併用化学療法により転移性疾患は奏効した。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における稀な消化管症状に注目している。
pmid-30410697.summary_en: Case report of massive gastrointestinal bleeding from jejunal metastasis of ovarian choriocarcinoma in a young woman. Bleeding localized by CT angiography after inconclusive endoscopies. Resection and combination chemotherapy successfully treated metastatic disease, highlighting rare gastrointestinal manifestation of ovarian GCT.

pmid-30412064.summary_ja: 胎盤着床部栄養膜腫瘍（PSTT）の血栓性微小血管障害関連症例。初期診断は慢性糸球体腎炎であった。子宮全摘除と卵管切除により治癒。PSTT とTMAの関連性を提示。
pmid-30412064.summary_en: Case report of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasm, presenting with thrombotic microangiopathy. 28-year-old woman initially misdiagnosed with glomerulonephritis. Hysterectomy with bilateral salpingectomy cured PSTT and resolved thrombotic complications.

pmid-30412106.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた悪性黒色腫の症例報告。免疫チェックポイント阻害薬(イピリムマブ、ペムブロリズマブ)で治療した。免疫組織化学によるPD-L1データと有害事象を示した初の症例である。免疫療法への反応は乏しかったが、腫瘍を有したまま14か月生存した。
pmid-30412106.summary_en: Case report of malignant melanoma arising in ovarian cystic teratoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ipilimumab and pembrolizumab). First reported case with immunohistochemical PD-L1 data and adverse events. Achieved 14-month tumor-bearing survival despite poor response to immunotherapy.

pmid-30413968.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における疑わしい後腹膜リンパ節の生存可能性を判定する新規分子画像診断法をレビューした総説。従来のCTの限界と、特にセミノーマにおけるPET/FDG画像診断の可能性を論じる。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の課題にも言及している。確証的研究は現時点では不足している。
pmid-30413968.summary_en: Reviews novel molecular imaging modalities for determining viability of suspicious retroperitoneal lymph nodes in testicular germ cell tumors. Discusses limitations of conventional CT and potential of PET/FDG imaging, particularly for seminoma, and challenges with nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-30415106.summary_ja: 治癒が現実的でなくなった転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する緩和的治療の選択肢を扱う叙述的総説。シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けても約10〜15%の患者が最終的に死亡することに言及している。根治を目的とすることが適切でなくなった場合の管理戦略に焦点を当てる。
pmid-30415106.summary_en: Narrative review of palliative treatment options for metastatic germ cell cancer patients where cure is no longer realistic. Addresses approximately 10-15% of metastatic GCC patients who die despite cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Focuses on management strategies when curative intent is no longer appropriate.

pmid-30415744.summary_ja: 妊娠中の薬物輸送評価のためのiPSC由来合胞体栄養膜モデルの開発。絨毛癌細胞との比較と妊娠中薬物療法の安全性評価に応用。
pmid-30415744.summary_en: Develops in vitro syncytiotrophoblast model using retinoic acid-differentiated iPSCs for placental drug transport studies during pregnancy. Uses choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells as reference and demonstrates hCG secretion for 28 days, relevant to gestational trophoblastic disease research.

pmid-30418048.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のサブタイプにおける5遺伝子(CRIPTO、HOXA9、MGMT、RASSF1A、SCGB3A1)のプロモーターメチル化パターンを評価した研究。遺伝子の組み合わせにより、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍を識別できた。メチル化パターンは腫瘍病期および攻撃性と関連していた。
pmid-30418048.summary_en: Evaluates promoter methylation patterns of five genes (CRIPTO, HOXA9, MGMT, RASSF1A, SCGB3A1) in testicular germ cell tumor subtypes. Different gene combinations discriminate between seminomas and nonseminomatous tumors with methylation patterns correlating with tumor stage and aggressiveness.

pmid-30418405.summary_ja: 60歳男性の下眼瞼デルモイド嚢胞。報告例非常に稀。成人での外傷なき発症。眼瞼病変の鑑別診断を検討した臨床例。
pmid-30418405.summary_en: Case report of dermoid cyst (teratoma) in superficial lower eyelid of 60-year-old man, extremely rare location with only one previous case reported. Unusual adult presentation without associated trauma. Discusses differential diagnosis of eyelid lesions.

pmid-30427104.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を伴う卵巣奇形腫の神経膠組織を、形態学的および免疫組織化学的に特徴づけた研究。脳炎例では、NMDA受容体発現神経細胞がより密に凝集し小型で、Ki-67標識指数とB細胞の集簇が増加していた。対照例と比較して示された。本所見は診断の精度向上や病態理解に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-30427104.summary_en: Morphological and immunohistochemical characterization of neuroglial tissue in ovarian teratomas associated with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. Found NMDA receptor-expressing neurons more densely aggregated and smaller in encephalitis cases with increased Ki-67 labeling and B-cell infiltration compared to controls.

pmid-30428870.summary_ja: 12歳男児の再発性球結膜類皮嚢腫(嚢胞性奇形腫)に対し、外科的切除、羊膜移植、局所マイトマイシンCを行った症例報告。この併用法を用いた初の報告である。病変の完全切除と移植片の接着が得られ、良好な臨床転帰が示された。眼表面の再発性奇形腫の管理に有効な手法を示している。
pmid-30428870.summary_en: Case report of recurrent epibulbar dermoid cyst (cystic teratoma) in 12-year-old boy treated with surgical excision, amniotic membrane implant, and topical mitomycin C. First reported case using this combination approach. Demonstrates successful technique for managing recurrent ocular surface teratomas.

pmid-30430771.summary_ja: セミノーマのシスプラチン耐性機序を分子レベルで検討。H19 lncRNAがmiRNA-106b-5pをシーケスターしTDRG1発現を促進。化学療法耐性セミノーマの新規治療標的を提唱。
pmid-30430771.summary_en: Investigates cisplatin resistance mechanisms in seminoma through molecular analysis. Found long non-coding RNA H19 upregulated in resistant cells, acting as miRNA-106b-5p sponge to promote TDRG1 expression via PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway. Proposes therapeutic targets for chemoresistant seminoma.

pmid-30443122.summary_ja: 肝十二指腸間膜に生じた奇形腫の症例報告。報告例が15例のみの極めて稀な部位である。幼児例に対し外科的切除が成功した。隣接する構造物による術中合併症を避けるため、術前の正確な解剖学的局在の把握が重要であると強調している。
pmid-30443122.summary_en: Case report of teratoma in hepatoduodenal ligament, extremely rare site with only 15 previously reported cases. Presented in toddler with successful surgical excision. Emphasizes importance of preoperative anatomical localization to avoid intraoperative complications with adjacent structures.

pmid-30443123.summary_ja: 3歳男児の胃卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。血清AFPが21,000 ng/mlと高値で、肝臓および大網への転移を伴い、黒色便で発症した。化学療法(PEB)と胃スリーブ切除術後、病理組織学的に残存腫瘍は認められず、AFPも正常化した。
pmid-30443123.summary_en: Case report of yolk sac tumor of stomach in 3-year-old boy with elevated serum AFP (21,000 ng/ml). Presented with recurrent melena and metastases to liver and omentum. Achieved complete response with chemotherapy (PEB) and surgical resection with marker normalization.

pmid-30446456.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の680例中22例でgrowing teratoma syndromeを後方視的に解析した研究。腫瘍マーカーが正常化していても完全外科的切除が必要とされる。全生存率は95.5%、再発は9%であったが、重篤な合併症を伴うため専門施設での治療が求められる。
pmid-30446456.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 22 patients with growing teratoma syndrome among 680 with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. GTS requires complete surgical resection despite normalized tumor markers. High survival rate (95.5%) with 9% relapse, but significant morbidity requiring specialized centers.

pmid-30447843.summary_ja: 米国対がん合同委員会(AJCC)第8版の病期分類マニュアルにおける、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関する重要な変更点を概説している。更新された病期分類基準と報告基準を論じ、GCTの分類に残された課題を示す。
pmid-30447843.summary_en: Reviews critical changes in American Joint Committee for Cancer eighth edition staging manual for testicular germ cell tumors. Discusses updated staging criteria and reporting standards for testis GCTs and highlights remaining classification challenges.

pmid-30448638.summary_ja: 15歳女児の無症候性穿通性縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例報告。右上葉を穿通していた腫瘍を、完全胸腔鏡下の外科的切除により治療した。症状の少ない症例では、大きな穿通性奇形腫であっても低侵襲アプローチが実行可能であることを示している。
pmid-30448638.summary_en: Case report of 15-year-old girl with asymptomatic mediastinal mature teratoma perforating the right upper lobe. Successfully treated with complete thoracoscopic surgical resection. Demonstrates feasibility of minimally invasive approach for large perforating teratomas with limited symptoms.

pmid-30456189.summary_ja: セミノーマと非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍のリンパ節病期分類および治療後フォローアップにおける画像検査（CT、MRI、PET）の役割と限界について概説し、微小転移病巣の検出における課題を指摘している。
pmid-30456189.summary_en: Reviews imaging techniques (CT, MRI, PET) for lymph node staging and follow-up in seminomatous and non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, addressing the limitations of conventional imaging in detecting micro-metastatic disease.

pmid-30456190.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍、特にセミノーマにおけるF-FDG PET/CTの画像診断について概説している。欧州ガイドラインの推奨内容と、病期分類、治療効果判定、再発検出の改善に関する新たな臨床エビデンスを論じる。
pmid-30456190.summary_en: Reviews F-FDG PET/CT imaging in testicular germ cell tumors, particularly seminomas. Discusses European guideline recommendations and emerging clinical evidence for improved staging, treatment response assessment, and recurrence detection.

pmid-30456287.summary_ja: 女性患者に生じた原発性縦隔絨毛癌のまれな症例報告であり、非定型的なゲノム欠失を伴っていた。血清hCGが陰性であったため、組織学的診断が必要であった。この非典型的な胚細胞腫瘍の臨床像と治療について論じている。
pmid-30456287.summary_en: Rare case report of primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma in a female patient with atypical genomic losses. Absence of serum hCG required histologic diagnosis. Discusses clinical features and management of this unusual germ cell tumor presentation.

pmid-30465413.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST)の若年女性患者における温存手術と医学的治療の多職種的評価の総説。YSTは卵巣精原細胞腫瘍で第3位。化学療法感受性と改善された治療で予後向上。
pmid-30465413.summary_en: Narrative review of fertility-sparing surgical and medical approach for young women with yolk sac tumor (YST), the third most common ovarian GCT. YSTs are chemosensitive tumors, supporting less aggressive fertility-sparing surgery. Improved modern chemotherapeutic regimens have significantly improved prognosis for this rare neoplasia.

pmid-30466239.summary_ja: 乳幼児の稀な巨大頭顔部奇形腫でproboscis lateralis表現型を呈した症例。奇形腫は小児の最も一般的な頭外性精原細胞腫瘍。複雑な頭蓋内外成分を有し多職種手術を要する。
pmid-30466239.summary_en: Case report of rare giant craniofacial teratoma in newborn presenting with proboscis lateralis phenotype. Teratomas are most common extragonadal GCT in childhood. Craniofacial teratomas are rare but can have complex intra- and extra-cranial components requiring multistage multidisciplinary surgical approach.

pmid-30466984.summary_ja: ナリンゲニンが胎盤絨毛癌細胞の増殖を活性酸素とMAPK経路(p38、JNK)で抑制した研究。生存性・移動能低下、ミトコンドリア依存性アポトーシス誘導。化学療法抵抗性絨毛癌の治療薬候補。
pmid-30466984.summary_en: Study investigating naringenin's anti-cancer effects on human placental choriocarcinoma cells (JAR and JEG3). Naringenin reduced viability and migration, induced ROS-mediated mitochondrial apoptosis, and activated p38 and JNK MAPK pathways in dose-dependent manner. Suggests naringenin as potential therapeutic agent for chemotherapy-resistant gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-30483317.summary_ja: 心毒性圧迫を引き起こした乳幼児の心嚢内奇形腫症例。良性成熟奇形腫が確認された稀な心原発腫瘍。適切な麻酔・外科治療で良好な経過と正常心機能。
pmid-30483317.summary_en: Case report of 34-day-old infant with intrapericardial teratoma causing cardiovascular compression requiring emergency surgery. Histologic examination confirmed benign mature teratoma. Excellent postoperative outcome with normal cardiac function at 8-month follow-up. Demonstrates successful anesthetic and surgical management of rare cardiac germ cell tumor.

pmid-30503260.summary_ja: ヒト多能性幹細胞由来奇形腫における未分化・悪性細胞検出にmiR-371族がバイオマーカーとして機能することを示した。ヒト悪性精原細胞腫瘍細胞株も検討。多能性幹細胞移植のがんリスク評価に有用。
pmid-30503260.summary_en: Study investigating microRNA-371 family as plasma biomarkers for detecting undifferentiated and potentially malignant elements in teratomas from human pluripotent stem cells. Multiple hPSC and human malignant GCT lines studied. miR-371 family members detected in mouse plasma accurately reflect presence of undifferentiated elements. Provides method to assess cancer risk in pluripotent stem cell-derived teratomas.

pmid-30508960.summary_ja: 全GTDの0.23～3%を占める稀な妊娠性絨毛性疾患である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の2症例報告。1例目は胞状奇胎に続発し、2例目は流産の5年後に発症した。診断は掻爬術または生検後の組織学的検査で確定した。子宮摘出術により良好な経過が得られた。hCG測定と画像診断による経過観察の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-30508960.summary_en: Two case reports of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare gestational trophoblastic disease accounting for 0.23-3% of all GTD. First case presented with molar pregnancy, second arose 5 years post-miscarriage. Diagnosis confirmed by histology following D&C or biopsy. Treatment: hysterectomy with good outcomes. Emphasizes importance of hCG monitoring and imaging in management.

pmid-30514248.summary_ja: 小児前縦隔成熟奇形腫3例が咳血と胸膜炎で初発し、結核・膿胸と誤診されたもの。膵組織を含む奇形腫。外科切除で全例良好経過。前縦隔奇形腫の診断に対する臨床警戒の必要性。
pmid-30514248.summary_en: Three pediatric cases of mediastinal mature teratomas with pancreatic tissue presenting with hemoptysis and/or chest pain, initially misdiagnosed as tuberculosis or empyema. Imaging mimicked TB with calcification and pleural changes. Complete surgical excision achieved good outcomes. Emphasizes need for clinical suspicion of mediastinal teratoma in children.

pmid-30515295.summary_ja: 卵巣に38×32×23 cmの巨大粘液性囊胞腺腫と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の関連病変。経皮的ドレナージと小開腹による最小侵襲的治療で成功。巨大卵巣腫瘍の安全で効果的な治療法。
pmid-30515295.summary_en: Case report of 26-year-old with giant 38×32×23 cm ovarian mass revealed as mucinous cystadenoma associated with mature cystic teratoma. Minimal invasive approach used: percutaneous drainage followed by mini-laparotomy with complete tumor removal. Demonstrates effective treatment modality for giant ovarian teratoma.

pmid-30519350.summary_ja: 精原細胞腫瘍75例におけるMPHOSPH1発現の臨床病理学的意義を検討。胚細胞癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍で高発現、遠隔転移と関連。MPHOSPH1阻害は細胞移動・浸潤を減少させた。治療標的と予後バイオマーカーの可能性。
pmid-30519350.summary_en: Study of MPHOSPH1 expression in 75 testicular GCT samples. High expression found in embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor compared to seminoma, associated with distant metastasis and advanced disease. MPHOSPH1 knockdown reduced cell migration, invasion, and proliferation in EC cell lines, suggesting potential therapeutic target and prognostic biomarker.

pmid-30524172.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞癌温存手術とBEP化学療法後8年で自然妊娠・出産した症例。健常な女児を分娩。卵巣精原細胞腫瘍の温存治療後の生殖機能温存と良好な予後を示した。
pmid-30524172.summary_en: Case report demonstrating successful pregnancy eight years after fertility-sparing treatment of ovarian embryonal carcinoma (FIGO stage III c). Patient underwent unilateral salpingooophorectomy and BEP chemotherapy, conceived spontaneously, and delivered healthy baby without congenital abnormalities. Demonstrates preserved reproductive function after aggressive treatment of ovarian GCT.

pmid-30533005.summary_ja: 精原細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的特徴の総説。12p獲得は症例の100%に、i(12p)は80%に認められる。KIT/KITLG経路など複数遺伝子が腫瘍形成に関与。精子細胞腫瘍は9番染色体獲得を特徴とした。
pmid-30533005.summary_en: Comprehensive cytogenomic review of testicular GCT highlighting consistent gain of chromosome 12p material (~100% of cases), isochromosome 12p in 80%, and associated genes (DPPA3, SOX5, KIT/KITLG pathway). Discusses spermatocytic tumors with chromosome 9 gain and genome-wide association findings in TGCT pathogenesis.

pmid-30533236.summary_ja: 精巣混合精原細胞腫瘍が絨毛癌症候群で初発した17歳の症例。極度に高いhCG値(222,493 IU/L)と転移性疾患を呈した。予後不良なNSGCTの典型例。
pmid-30533236.summary_en: Case report of 17-year-old with testicular mixed germ cell tumor presenting with choriocarcinoma syndrome, extremely elevated hCG (222,493 IU/L), and metastatic lung/bone/retroperitoneal disease. Demonstrates poor-risk nonseminomatous GCT with acute clinical presentation requiring specialized oncologic care and intensive supportive management.

pmid-30533300.summary_ja: 付属器捻転42例の外科治療成績の比較。最頻病理は単純囊胞で、2番目が奇形腫。腹腔鏡手術は開腹手術と比較して腫瘍サイズが小さく、入院期間が短かった。
pmid-30533300.summary_en: Retrospective study of 42 women with surgically-proven adnexal torsion. Most common pathology was simple ovarian cyst, followed by mature teratoma. Laparoscopic approach showed advantages of smaller tumor size and shorter hospital stay compared to laparotomy. Demonstrates clinical outcomes in management of ovarian teratoma.

pmid-30538404.summary_ja: 前縦隔混合精原細胞腫瘍2例で血管形成性病変を呈したもの。1例は肉腫性血管肉腫を伴い、他方は良性海綿状血管腫を認めた。体細胞成分の稀な悪性所見と予後への影響。
pmid-30538404.summary_en: Case reports of two young males with mediastinal mixed germ cell tumors presenting with unusual vascular components. One case showed malignant angiosarcoma within the GCT, the other benign hemangioma. Highlights rare somatic malignancies in extragonadal GCT with significant prognostic implications.

pmid-30542732.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性精原細胞腫瘍の研究用にPDXモデルを確立した研究。移植後、組織内のリンパ球が形質細胞腫に変換する現象を観察。PDXモデル確立における新たな課題を指摘した。
pmid-30542732.summary_en: Study establishing patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models from testicular GCT metastases to investigate cisplatin-resistant disease. Observed unexpected lymphoma transformation in xenografts, suggesting tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes transform in immunodeficient mice. Identifies new challenges in PDX model development for GCT research.

pmid-30545544.summary_ja: NIPT検査で偶発的に検出された母体悪性腫瘍（ジスゲルミノーマを含む）の症例報告。NIPT検査のコピー数異常プロファイルが母体悪性腫瘍検出の可能性を示唆。ジスゲルミノーマ症例は妊娠中の卵巣GCT検出におけるNIPTの潜在的有用性を実証。
pmid-30545544.summary_en: Case reports of maternal malignancies detected incidentally on NIPT including dysgerminoma (ovarian germ cell tumor), cervical cancer, and gastric cancer. Copy number variation profiles in NIPT can identify coexisting maternal malignancies. Dysgerminoma case demonstrates potential diagnostic utility of NIPT in detecting GCT in pregnant population.

pmid-30546464.summary_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌における扁平上皮癌マーカー（CK5/6、p63、p40）の発現パターンを検討。肺絨毛癌が形態学的・免疫組織化学的に扁平上皮癌に模倣可能なことを実証。肺生検での診断ピットフォールの認識の重要性を強調。
pmid-30546464.summary_en: Histopathological study of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma (PPC) examining immunohistochemical markers (CK5/6, p63, p40) typically used for lung squamous cell carcinoma. Demonstrates PPCs can morphologically and immunohistochemically mimic SqCC, creating diagnostic pitfalls. Emphasizes need for awareness when encountering choriocarcinoma in pulmonary biopsies.

pmid-30546889.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌の腹腔鏡下温存療法による妊娠・出産症例。奇形腫内の悪性転化が生殖能温存で管理可能なことを実証。奇形腫管理における稀な合併症の考慮の重要性を強調。
pmid-30546889.summary_en: Case report of papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in mature ovarian cystic teratoma treated with laparoscopic fertility-sparing surgery resulting in live birth after 6 years. Demonstrates that malignant transformation within ovarian teratoma can be managed with fertility preservation. Highlights importance of considering such rare complications in teratoma management.

pmid-30547014.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における新規予後バイオマーカーに関する総説。IGCCCG 1997年確立の従来型マーカー（腫瘍部位、転移部位、腫瘍マーカー）から分子バイオマーカーへの進化を論述。予後層別化の現在の知見を総括。
pmid-30547014.summary_en: Comprehensive review of emerging prognostic biomarkers in testicular germ cell tumors (GCTs). Discusses evolution from established markers (IGCCCG 1997) including tumor site, metastatic sites, and serum markers (AFP, β-hCG, LDH) to novel molecular biomarkers. Summarizes current knowledge on prognostic stratification beyond traditional clinical parameters.

pmid-30560102.summary_ja: 14歳男性の鼻中隔に発生したGrade-3未熟奇形腫の頭蓋内伸展症例。内視鏡的切除と補助化学療法で治療。未熟奇形腫の発生部位としては鼻中隔は極めて稀。2年追跡で再発なし。
pmid-30560102.summary_en: Case report of Grade-3 immature teratoma arising from nasal septum in 14-year-old male with intracranial extension. Endoscopic resection achieved with adjuvant chemotherapy. Extremely rare site for immature teratoma (nasal septum) with intracranial involvement. No recurrence after 2-year follow-up.

pmid-30563561.summary_ja: エストロゲン療法開始15ヶ月後に転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症したMTFトランスジェンダー患者の症例。後腹膜腫瘤、水腎症、腫瘍マーカー上昇（β-hCG 2526、LDH 5294）を伴う。トランスジェンダー集団におけるエストロゲンの精巣がん発生への関与を示唆。
pmid-30563561.summary_en: Case report of metastatic testicular germ cell cancer in 38-year-old male-to-female transgender patient 15 months after initiating estrogen therapy. Presented with extensive retroperitoneal mass, hydronephrosis, and elevated germ cell tumor markers (β-hCG 2526, LDH 5294). Raises questions about estrogen's role in testicular cancer development in transgender population.

pmid-30567058.summary_ja: 突然の腹痛で発症した65歳女性の肝臓破裂成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例。成人の肝臓胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀（既報11例のみ）。外科的切除と病理組織学的確認を実施。成人肝臓奇形腫の破裂は極めて稀。
pmid-30567058.summary_en: Case report of ruptured mature cystic teratoma in liver of 65-year-old female presenting with acute abdominal pain. Extragonadal hepatic teratoma is extremely rare in adults (only 11 prior case reports). Surgical resection with histopathological confirmation performed. Unique presentation of mass rupture in adult hepatic teratoma.

pmid-30568363.summary_ja: 35歳男性のPMDSおよびtransverse testicular ectopia(TTE)に伴う精巣セミノーマの症例報告。PMDSは、表現型が男性でありながら子宮、卵管、膣などのミュラー管由来構造が残存する疾患である。PMDS、TTE、精巣セミノーマの併存はきわめてまれである。
pmid-30568363.summary_en: Case report of testicular seminoma in a 35-year-old male with Persistent Müllerian Duct Syndrome (PMDS) and transverse testicular ectopia (TTE). PMDS characterized by persistence of Müllerian derivatives (uterus, fallopian tubes, vagina) in phenotypic male. Combination of PMDS, TTE, and testicular seminoma is extremely rare.

pmid-30569854.summary_ja: SEERデータベースを用いた集団ベース研究で、卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍(OGCT)におけるリンパ節郭清の予後への影響を病期別に解析した。傾向スコアマッチングを施した1,996例の解析では、リンパ節郭清は病期III・IVの生存を有意に改善したが、早期病期には有意な影響は認められなかった。OGCTの治療において、リンパ節郭清は病期に応じた役割を持つことが示された。
pmid-30569854.summary_en: Population-based study using SEER database analyzing lymphadenectomy impact on malignant ovarian germ cell tumor (OGCT) prognosis across disease stages. Propensity score matching analysis of 1,996 OGCT patients showed lymphadenectomy significantly improved stage III/IV survival but not early-stage outcomes. Demonstrates stage-dependent role of lymphadenectomy in OGCT management.

pmid-30572559.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫内に生じた悪性甲状腺腫瘍（ストルマオバリ）の広範な腹膜転移症例。初回卵巣摘出術14年後に発症。全甲状腺摘出と放射性ヨウ素治療で治療。卵巣奇形腫の稀な合併症の管理戦略を実証。
pmid-30572559.summary_en: Case of malignant struma ovarii with extensive peritoneal metastasis 14 years after initial ovariectomy. Struma ovarii represents thyroid tissue malignancy arising within an ovarian teratoma. Treated with total thyroidectomy and radioactive iodine therapy. Demonstrates management strategy for this rare complication of ovarian teratoma.

pmid-30577584.summary_ja: 5-アザシチジンの胚細胞がん細胞株（NCCIT、2102Ep）に対する効果を研究。低ナノモル濃度でアポトーシスを誘導し、耐性細胞でシスプラチン感受性を部分的に復活。DNA脱メチル化剤がシスプラチン耐性非セミノーマGCTの治療に有効である可能性を示唆。
pmid-30577584.summary_en: Study of 5-azacitidine (5-aza) effects on cisplatin-sensitive and -resistant embryonal carcinoma cell lines (NCCIT, 2102Ep). 5-aza induced apoptosis at nanomolar concentrations and partially restored cisplatin sensitivity in resistant cells. Suggests DNA demethylating agents may enhance cisplatin efficacy in refractory non-seminomatous GCT.

pmid-30579363.summary_ja: 妊娠27週の軟口蓋から発生した未熟奇形腫と頭蓋内腫瘍伸展の剖検例。エピグナトゥスと頭蓋内腫瘍はいずれも未熟奇形腫で、神経および肺成分を含む。脳実質への侵襲なく直接頭蓋内に伸展する稀な症例。
pmid-30579363.summary_en: Autopsy case of epignathus (immature teratoma) originating from soft palate with intracranial extension in a 27-week gestation fetus. Both epignathus and intracranial tumor were histologically immature teratomas with neural and pulmonary components. Demonstrates rare case of direct cranial expansion without brain invasion.

pmid-30581773.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおけるHOXA10転写因子の発現と機能に関する研究。組織マイクロアレーと細胞培養研究により、HOXA10の核機能喪失がセミノーマと非セミノーマの増殖に関連することを示唆。TP53、cKit、STAT3経路を介した精巣がん発展制御機構を示唆。
pmid-30581773.summary_en: Investigation of HOXA10 transcription factor expression and function in testicular cancer. Tissue microarray and cell culture studies show HOXA10 nuclear loss associated with seminoma and non-seminoma proliferation. HOXA10 inhibition of cancer cell proliferation suggests its role in regulating testicular cancer development through TP53, cKit, and STAT3 signaling.

pmid-30587745.summary_ja: 前縦隔セミノーマによる上大静脈侵襲患者の外科的治療症例。小径カテーテルによる一時的バイパスを使用したSVC再建術を施行。セミノーマ管理における上大静脈置換の技術的実行可能性を実証。
pmid-30587745.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old male with anterior mediastinal seminoma invading superior vena cava (SVC). Surgical resection with SVC reconstruction using expanded polytetrafluoroethylene graft performed with temporary bypass grafting. Demonstrates technical feasibility of combined SVC replacement in seminoma management.

pmid-30589036.summary_ja: セレノシスチンのJEG-3ヒト絨毛癌細胞に対する抗がん効果の研究。ROS媒介酸化的損傷を介してS期停止とアポトーシスを誘導。マウス担がん個体でも絨毛癌腫瘍成長を抑制し、絨毛癌治療への応用の可能性を示唆。
pmid-30589036.summary_en: Investigation of selenocystine (SeC) anti-cancer effects against JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells in vitro and in vivo. SeC induced S-phase arrest and apoptosis through ROS-mediated oxidative damage. Suppressed choriocarcinoma xenograft growth in mice, suggesting potential therapeutic application in choriocarcinoma treatment.

pmid-30591201.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞を用いたTNF-αの血管新生への影響研究。TNF-α刺激下での胎盤成長因子とVEGF-A産生を検討。TNF-αはPlGF/VEGFR1およびVEGF-A/VEGFR2経路の相乗作用を介して血管新生を促進することを示唆。
pmid-30591201.summary_en: Study investigating TNF-α effects on angiogenesis in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells. Examined placental growth factor and VEGF-A production in response to TNF-α stimulation. Results show TNF-α promotes angiogenesis via PlGF/VEGFR1 and VEGF-A/VEGFR2 pathway interactions relevant to choriocarcinoma biology.

pmid-30593757.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の右室への稀な心臓転移症例。原発巣は転移発見後に検出された。病理診断・免疫組織化学によるマーカー発現（hCG、AFP、CD30など）検査で診断確定。胚細胞腫瘍の心転移に関する文献レビューを含む。
pmid-30593757.summary_en: Case report of rare cardiac metastasis from testicular embryonal carcinoma in a 35-year-old male. Primary tumor discovered after cardiac metastasis revealing. Diagnostic approach using immunohistochemistry with GCT markers (hCG, AFP) and cytokeratin/CD30 expression described. Literature review on cardiac metastases provided.

pmid-30607283.summary_ja: 52歳男性の原発性胃卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例で、腫瘍は腸間膜に転移していた。当初は低分化腺癌と誤診され、胃切除術を受けていた。病理組織学およびAFP免疫染色により卵黄嚢腫瘍と確定した。胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法プロトコルに良好に反応した。
pmid-30607283.summary_en: Case of 52-year-old man with primary gastric yolk sac tumor that metastasized to mesentery. Initially misdiagnosed as poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma requiring gastrectomy. Histopathology with AFP immunostaining confirmed yolk sac tumor. Patient responded well to germ cell tumor chemotherapy protocols.

pmid-30618041.summary_ja: 稀な女性生殖器悪性腫瘍である絨毛癌の診断と治療原則の総説。疫学、FIGO分類、化学療法レジメンと手術選択肢について、臨床経験と文献レビューに基づいて記述。この稀な疾患の包括的な管理戦略を提供。
pmid-30618041.summary_en: Review of diagnosis and current treatment principles for choriocarcinoma, a rare female reproductive malignancy. Discusses epidemiology, FIGO classification, chemotherapy regimens, and surgical options based on clinical case experience and literature review. Provides comprehensive overview of management strategies for this uncommon disease.

pmid-30648062.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫に関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎の副腫瘍症候群。サウジアラビアからの初報告。21歳女性が精神神経症状と下肢麻痺で発症。血清とCSFで抗NMDA受容体抗体陽性。卵巣摘出後に神経症状が劇的に改善。
pmid-30648062.summary_en: First reported case from Saudi Arabia of paraneoplastic anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with mature ovarian teratoma in 21-year-old woman presenting with neuropsychiatric symptoms and paralysis. Serum and CSF tested positive for anti-NMDA receptor antibodies. Post-oophorectomy, symptoms resolved dramatically without additional immunotherapy.

pmid-30652161.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛癌の転移に伴う巨大骨盤動静脈瘻による月経過多と肺塞栓の極めて稀な症例。経動脈的・経静脈的塞栓術と全身化学療法の併用で完全奛寛解を達成。動静脈瘻の消失を確認。
pmid-30652161.summary_en: Case of young woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma complicated by giant pelvic arterio-venous fistula causing metrorrhagia and pulmonary embolism. Successfully treated with multimodal transcatheter embolization combining transarterial and transvenous approaches. Complete response achieved with chemotherapy and arterio-venous fistula resolution.

pmid-30652572.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節腫瘤について、ラジオミクスを用いて病理を予測した研究である。77例の解析で、腫瘤が生存腫瘍・成熟奇形腫か線維化かを判別した。ラジオミクスと臨床変数を組み合わせることで線維化の予測精度は88%に達し、選択された患者では後腹膜リンパ節郭清を回避できる可能性がある。
pmid-30652572.summary_en: Study using radiomics to predict pathology of postchemotherapy retroperitoneal nodal masses in testicular germ cell tumors. Analysis of 77 patients identified whether masses contained viable tumor/mature teratoma versus fibrosis. Radiomics combined with clinical variables achieved 88% accuracy in predicting fibrosis, potentially avoiding RPLND in selected patients.

pmid-30662051.summary_ja: 1978年に26歳で前縦隔の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ成分を伴う奇形腫)と診断された症例。2年後に後腹膜に再発し、初回治療から36年後に肺に再発した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の長期的な経過と晩期再発の様式を示している。
pmid-30662051.summary_en: Case of extragonadal germ cell tumor (teratoma with seminoma components) in anterior mediastinum diagnosed at age 26 in 1978. Recurrence in retroperitoneum 2 years later, then lung recurrence 36 years after initial treatment. Demonstrates long-term disease course and late recurrence pattern of extragonadal GCTs.

pmid-30692298.summary_ja: 小腸原発絨毛癌の73歳男性症例で、黒色便と貧血で発症。複数の小腸腫瘍、腸間膜リンパ節転移、肺肝転移を認め、血中hCG著しく上昇。初期治療後も8ヶ月で死亡。
pmid-30692298.summary_en: Case of 73-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the small intestine presenting with melena and severe anemia. Imaging revealed multiple small intestinal tumors with mesenteric lymph node and extensive lung/liver metastases. Markedly elevated blood hCG. Despite chemotherapy, patient died 8 months post-surgery.

pmid-30692823.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の甲状腺優位亜型であるストルマオバリイの3症例。閉経後女性2例は卵巣悪性腫瘍の疑いで手術、若年女性1例はCA-125上昇で手術。術前診断困難で卵巣悪性腫瘍として過度な検査が行われることがあるが、良好な予後。
pmid-30692823.summary_en: Report of three cases of struma ovarii, a variant of mature cystic teratoma with predominant thyroid tissue. Cases included two postmenopausal women suspected of ovarian malignancy and one younger woman with raised CA-125. Benign tumors often misdiagnosed preoperatively as ovarian malignancy, with good prognosis.

pmid-30693128.summary_ja: 縦隔悪性奇形腫の患者に発生した悪性黒色腫の稀な症例。14歳男児で、化学療法後にもかかわらず急速に進行し、診断後15ヶ月で死亡。奇形腫からの悪性黒色腫転化の報告は極めて稀である。
pmid-30693128.summary_en: Case of 14-year-old boy with mediastinal malignant teratoma who developed metastatic malignant melanoma originating from the teratoma. Despite initial chemotherapy with negative AFP, he had rapid progression with bone metastasis and died 15 months after diagnosis, making this the second reported case of this rare transformation.

pmid-30697302.summary_ja: 30歳女性の両側卵巣の肝様亜型卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。広範な腹腔内転移と肺転移を伴っていた。血清AFPは34,244 ng/mLと著明に高値であった。病理組織学と免疫組織化学により診断が確定し、この稀な腫瘍亜型の攻撃的な性質を示している。
pmid-30697302.summary_en: Case report of hepatoid variant of yolk sac tumor in both ovaries in 30-year-old woman with widespread intra-abdominal and lung metastasis. Markedly elevated serum AFP (34,244 ng/mL). Histopathology with immunohistochemistry confirmed diagnosis. Demonstrates aggressive behavior of this rare tumor variant.

pmid-30705885.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者171名を対象に、化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(PC-RPLND)における片側テンプレート切除と両側切除を比較した後方視的研究である。射精機能の温存を評価したところ、5cm未満の腫瘤に対するテンプレート切除では順行性射精の温存率が高かった。腫瘍学的転帰は同等であった。
pmid-30705885.summary_en: Study of 171 testicular cancer patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND). Compared unilateral template versus bilateral resection for preservation of ejaculatory function. Template resection with masses <5 cm showed better antegrade ejaculation preservation with equivalent oncologic outcomes.

pmid-30756052.summary_ja: 血清αフェトプロテインおよび乳酸脱水素酵素値が正常であった31歳男性の、卵黄嚢型の原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。身体診察と検査により精巣原発は除外された。診断は臨床的な高い疑いと病理組織学的所見に基づいて確定された。
pmid-30756052.summary_en: Unusual case of primary retroperitoneal yolk sac germ cell tumor in 31-year-old man with normal AFP and LDH levels, a presentation not previously described. Testicular primary was excluded by physical examination and imaging. Diagnosis confirmed by histopathology following high clinical suspicion.

pmid-30766756.summary_ja: 腸管原発の極めて稀な卵黄嚢腫瘍の2症例。7歳女児と29歳女性で、血清AFP値が著しく上昇（≥1,210 ng/mL）。組織学的および免疫組織化学的検査で卵黄嚢腫瘍を確認。多職種による診断と管理を実施。
pmid-30766756.summary_en: Two cases of primary intestinal yolk sac tumor, an extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. Patients aged 7 and 29 presented with markedly elevated serum AFP (≥1,210 ng/mL). Histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed yolk sac tumor with characteristic patterns. Both cases were successfully diagnosed through multidisciplinary evaluation.

pmid-30774829.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患患者の治療反応、生存率、化学療法後の妊娠転帰を調査。低リスク患者はメトトレキサートで100%完全奛寛解、高リスク患者は併用化学療法で91%の奛寛解率。多くの患者で生殖能力が保持され妊娠が可能であった。
pmid-30774829.summary_en: Study of 30 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) patients evaluating treatment response and pregnancy outcomes. Low-risk patients achieved 100% remission with methotrexate; high-risk patients achieved 91% remission with combination therapy. Follow-up showed good fertility preservation with successful pregnancies in majority of patients.

pmid-30775330.summary_ja: 59歳女性の卵巣成熟奇形腫内に発生した皮脂腺癌の稀な症例報告。文献上10例未満の報告しかない稀な悪性転化を示す。組織学的所見について詳述。
pmid-30775330.summary_en: Report of sebaceous carcinoma arising within a mature teratoma of the ovary in a 59-year-old patient. This rare malignant transformation has fewer than 10 cases reported in the literature. Histological findings and clinical presentation are discussed.

pmid-30792805.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の自然退縮について、「burned out」「shrinking seminoma」「pT0」腫瘍とも呼ばれる現象をレビューしている。まれに起こる、腫瘍の完全または部分的退縮と線維性瘢痕化を伴う現象を取り上げ、腫瘍マーカーの上昇と疑わしい精巣画像所見を呈することを述べている。この病態は最近WHO腫瘍分類で認識された。
pmid-30792805.summary_en: Reviews spontaneous regression of testicular germ-cell tumors, known as 'burned out,' 'shrinking seminoma,' or 'pT0' tumor. Discusses the uncommon phenomenon where complete or partial tumor regression occurs with fibrotic scarring, presenting with elevated tumor markers but suspicious testicular imaging. Recently recognized in WHO Classification of Tumours.

pmid-30831668.summary_ja: 病期I精上皮腫(10年前に診断)で積極的監視を受けていた78歳男性の症例。傍大動脈および腸骨リンパ節の腫大が出現した。当初セミノーマと診断されていたが、病理再検討で異時性マントル細胞リンパ腫と判明した。長期フォローアップでは二次性悪性腫瘍を考慮することの重要性を示している。
pmid-30831668.summary_en: Case of a 78-year-old man with stage I seminoma (diagnosed 10 years prior) managed with active surveillance who developed para-aortic and iliac lymph node enlargement. Despite initial seminoma diagnosis, pathological review revealed metachronous mantle cell lymphoma, highlighting the importance of considering secondary malignancies in long-term follow-up.

pmid-30848152.summary_ja: 卵巣のまれな胚細胞腫瘍であるstrumal carcinoidの症例報告。甲状腺組織とカルチノイド成分から構成される。無症状の46歳と52歳の女性2例で、いずれも成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の一部として認められた。両例とも増殖活性は低く、良性の経過と良好な予後が示された。
pmid-30848152.summary_en: Case report of strumal carcinoid of the ovary, a rare ovarian germ-cell tumor comprising thyroid tissue and carcinoid elements. Two asymptomatic women (46 and 52 years old) presented with tumors that were part of mature cystic teratoma. Both showed low proliferation activity and benign behavior with favorable prognosis.

pmid-30931135.summary_ja: 5年前に卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の外科的切除を受けた後、腹腔内に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の播種病変が生じた稀な合併症を報告する。脂肪、軟部組織、石灰化を含む多発病変が、画像および組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の播種と一致した。
pmid-30931135.summary_en: Reports an unusual complication of intra-peritoneal deposits of mature cystic teratoma material following surgical resection of an ovarian mature cystic teratoma 5 years prior. Multiple lesions containing fat, soft tissue, and calcification were found radiologically and histologically consistent with mature cystic teratoma seeding.

pmid-31058267.summary_ja: 2004～2014年の全国がんデータベースを用いた後方視的研究で、病期II/IIIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性5062名における化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(PC-RPLND)の実施状況と転帰を解析した。保険の種類がPC-RPLNDの受療に影響し、省略は全生存期間(全生存率)の低下と関連していた。
pmid-31058267.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) patterns and outcomes in 5062 men with stage II/III nonseminomatous germ cell tumors using National Cancer Database data (2004-2014). Insurance status influenced receipt of PC-RPLND, and omission was associated with worse overall survival.

pmid-31149504.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の進行期純粋セミノーマ症例の報告。第4選択の救援化学療法として高用量カルボプラチン・エトポシドを施行し完全寛解を得た。38歳男性(pT3N3M1aS3、中間リスク)で、腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、治療後27か月にわたり寛解が持続している。
pmid-31149504.summary_en: Case report of cisplatin-refractory advanced pure seminoma achieving complete remission after high-dose carboplatin and etoposide as fourth-line salvage chemotherapy. A 38-year-old man with intermediate-risk seminoma (pT3N3M1aS3) showed complete response with normal tumor markers and sustained remission at 27 months.

pmid-31149516.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に腸型低悪性度粘液性腫瘍を合併した症例。血清CEA値が上昇していた。免疫組織化学的にCK7-/CK20+を示し、奇形腫内粘液性腫瘍の診断に有用。
pmid-31149516.summary_en: Case of ovarian mature cystic teratoma with organized intestinal structures harboring low-grade mucinous neoplasm. A 66-year-old woman presented with elevated CEA level. The tumor mimicked appendiceal mucinous cystadenoma. Immunoprofile (CK7-/CK20+) helps distinguish mucinous neoplasia within mature ovarian teratomas.

pmid-31186984.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞がんと診断された成人患者への家族ケア経験の報告。後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う転移性疾患であった。家族中心のがん医療と親の役割転換が論じられている。
pmid-31186984.summary_en: Narrative case study describing a mother's experience caring for her adult son diagnosed with testicular embryonal carcinoma with metastatic retroperitoneal adenopathy. The paper emphasizes family-centered cancer care, communication strategies, and the unique role transition when caring for young adults with cancer.

pmid-31314383.summary_ja: 卵巣付属器疾患の総説。良性嚢胞性奇形腫は生理的嚢胞やのう腺腫とともに一般的な卵巣病変として認識されている。超音波で不確定な場合MRIが有用。
pmid-31314383.summary_en: Comprehensive review of adnexal masses including benign and malignant lesions. Benign cystic teratoma is recognized as a common ovarian lesion alongside physiological cysts and cystadeomas. MRI is recommended for problem-solving in sonographically indeterminate masses.

pmid-31327858.summary_ja: 両側同時性精巣セミノーマの症例。悪性リンパ腫との鑑別が困難であったが、組織学的にセミノーマと確定診断された。術後無再発経過である。
pmid-31327858.summary_en: Case report of bilateral synchronous testicular germ cell tumors presenting diagnostic challenges mimicking lymphoma. A 56-year-old man with bilateral testicular seminoma underwent sequential radical orchiectomy. Histopathologic examination confirmed seminoma in both testes, with excellent postoperative outcomes and no recurrence.

pmid-31435307.summary_ja: 先天性頸部奇形腫は胚外生殖細胞腫瘍である。新生児に発生した巨大頸部腫瘤で、MRIが腫瘍の性質と周囲構造への圧迫を明確にし、完全摘出術を可能にした。
pmid-31435307.summary_en: Congenital cervical teratomas are rare benign tumors arising from embryonic tissue layers. This case describes a full-term neonate with large cervical mass containing solid and cystic components. MRI effectively demonstrated mass composition and relationships to adjacent structures, facilitating complete surgical removal.

pmid-31754496.summary_ja: 前縦隔ジャーミノーマに伴う抗Ma2抗体関連傍腫瘍性脳炎の症例。視床下部と深部灰白質が主に侵され、ジャーミノーマに伴う神経学的合併症を示している。
pmid-31754496.summary_en: Anti-Ma2-antibody-associated paraneoplastic neurologic syndrome presenting with hypothalamic and deep grey nuclei involvement in a patient with anterior mediastinal germinoma. This unusual manifestation demonstrates the neurologic complications associated with mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-31773034.summary_ja: ステージIIB精巣セミノーマに対する陽子線治療の症例。後腹膜リンパ節転移を認めたが、完全奏効を達成し、15ヶ月無再発である。陽子線の線量分布特性が有利。
pmid-31773034.summary_en: This case report describes proton beam therapy for stage IIB testicular seminoma with a 2.7-cm retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis. The patient achieved complete response with no relapse at 15-month follow-up. Proton therapy's superior dose distribution to normal tissues offers advantages over conventional x-ray radiation.

pmid-31938257.summary_ja: 洞鼻腔奇形腺肉腫は悪性度が高く、複雑な組織構成を持つ腫瘍である。奇形腫成分とがん肉腫成分が混在する。2症例が化学放射線療法と手術で治療され、無再発経過を辿った。
pmid-31938257.summary_en: Sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS) is a highly malignant and aggressive neoplasm with complex mixed tissue composition including teratoma and carcinoma-sarcoma components. This paper reports two cases managed with radiotherapy, chemotherapy, and cranio-facial resection, with successful outcomes and no recurrence.

pmid-31938324.summary_ja: 耳外聴道の卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。血清AFP高値（664.60 ng/ml）を認め、化学療法後に腫瘍全摘出術を施行された。胚外生殖細胞腫瘍として重要な症例。
pmid-31938324.summary_en: Extra-gonadal pure yolk sac tumor of the external auditory canal is extremely rare. This case presents a patient with protruding mass from the ear canal, elevated serum AFP (664.60 ng/ml), and imaging showing large irregularly enhancing mass extending into the parapharyngeal space, treated with chemotherapy and surgical resection.

pmid-31949861.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍145例の後方視的な臨床病理学的・免疫組織化学的解析である。奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍は主に小児に発生し、18歳未満の患者は成人より生存良好であった。胚細胞腫瘍の亜型鑑別では、PLAPよりOCT4が優れた診断マーカーとして示された。
pmid-31949861.summary_en: Retrospective clinicopathological and immunohistochemical analysis of 145 testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs). Teratoma and yolk sac tumor predominantly occurred in children; prepubertal patients showed superior survival compared to adults. OCT4 emerged as a superior diagnostic marker compared to PLAP for distinguishing germ cell tumor subtypes.

pmid-32052237.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌転移に続発した巨大動静脈瘻の症例。経カテーテル塞栓術により完全に解決され、化学療法とともに良好な治療成績を達成した。
pmid-32052237.summary_en: This case describes a young woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma complicated by a giant pelvic arterio-venous fistula, hemorrhage, and pulmonary embolism. Multimodal transcatheter embolization using combined transarterial and transvenous approaches successfully resolved the fistula, preventing life-threatening complications.

pmid-32082744.summary_ja: 縦隔囊胞治療における胸腔鏡下手術と開胸術の比較研究。60例中、嚢胞性奇形腫7例が含まれた。胸腔鏡法が手術時間と入院期間を短縮した。
pmid-32082744.summary_en: This comparative study evaluates video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery versus thoracotomy for mediastinal cyst treatment in 60 patients. Seven cystic teratomas were identified among various mediastinal lesions. Thoracoscopic approach significantly reduced operative time and hospital stay with fewer postoperative complications.

pmid-32082795.summary_ja: 小児心臓原発腫瘍の手術治療経験。13例中、心膜奇形腫が1例含まれた。腫瘍の大多数は良性で、長期予後は良好であった。
pmid-32082795.summary_en: This paper presents 12-year surgical experience with primary cardiac tumors in childhood (13 patients). Cardiac teratoma represented one case among predominantly benign tumors (rhabdomyoma 7, fibroma 3, myxoma 2, pericardial teratoma 1), with excellent long-term outcomes despite overall mortality of 15.4%.

pmid-25492026.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞(P19.CL6)、ESC、iPSCを用いて、多能性幹細胞分化におけるmiR-1およびmiR-133aの役割を検討した。両miRNAは心筋分化の過程で発現が上昇し、miR-1は心筋分化を促進、miR-133aは抑制した。奇形腫形成実験によりin vivoでの作用も確認された。
pmid-25492026.summary_en: Study of miR-1 and miR-133a roles in pluripotent stem cell differentiation using embryonal carcinoma (P19.CL6) cells, ESCs, and iPSCs. Both miRNAs upregulated during cardiac differentiation; miR-1 enhanced while miR-133a reduced cardiac differentiation. Teratoma formation confirmed in vivo effects.

pmid-26365174.summary_ja: 出生時に完全口蓋裂を伴った女児の、鼻中隔由来の先天性奇形腫のまれな症例である。生後5か月で腫瘍を切除し、7か月で軟口蓋、14か月で硬口蓋を再建した。1年間のフォローアップで再発は認められず、組織学的検査で癌腫巣を伴わない完全切除が確認された。
pmid-26365174.summary_en: Rare case of congenital nasal septal teratoma causing complete cleft palate in female infant at birth. Tumor resected at 5 months, soft palate reconstruction at 7 months, hard palate closure at 14 months. No recurrence at 1-year follow-up; histology confirmed complete teratoma excision without carcinomatous foci.

pmid-26962678.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化を有する小児・思春期患者81例を対象に、7年間にわたり行われた多施設前向き研究である。93.8%で病変は不変であり、66.6%が両側性であった。フォローアップ中に2例がセミノーマ、1例が奇形腫を発症し、悪性腫瘍のリスクは低いが確実に存在することが示された。
pmid-26962678.summary_en: Prospective multicenter 7-year follow-up study of 81 pediatric/adolescent patients with testicular microlithiasis (TM). TM remained unchanged in 93.8%; bilateral involvement in 66.6%. Two patients developed seminoma and one developed teratoma during follow-up, demonstrating low but definite malignancy risk.

pmid-27033539.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者171名と前立腺がん患者66名における感情抑制と社会的制約が心理的苦痛に与える影響を調査。精巣がん患者では社会的制約が感情抑制と抑うつの関連を調整。
pmid-27033539.summary_en: Two-part study examining relationships between restrictive emotionality, social constraints, and psychological distress. Study 1: 171 testicular cancer patients showed social constraints moderating relationship between restrictive emotionality and depressive symptoms. Study 2: 66 prostate cancer patients showed only social constraints associated with depression.

pmid-27054654.summary_ja: 産褥期17歳の卵巣皮様嚢胞(12cm)捻転の症例。超音波検査で初期診断逃失。卵巣皮様嚢胞の同定ピットフォールと予防戦略を提示。3つの重要な教育的知見を強調。
pmid-27054654.summary_en: Case of 12-cm ovarian dermoid with torsion in 17-year-old postpartum female presenting with severe lower quadrant pain. Ultrasound initially missed diagnosis; paper discusses imaging pitfalls and preventive strategies. Demonstrates three teaching points regarding dermoid identification.

pmid-27165295.summary_ja: 45歳の再発古典的セミノーマ患者の症例報告。ビノレルビン(35 mg/m²)とフィルグラスチムによる化学療法併用動員により、自家HSCTのための幹細胞採取に成功した。2回目の動員でCD34+細胞のピークは32.6×10⁶ cells/Lに達し、4.73×10⁶ cells/kgを採取し、罹患率は最小限にとどまった。
pmid-27165295.summary_en: Case report of 45-year-old relapsed classical seminoma successfully mobilized for autologous HSCT using vinorelbine chemomobilization (35 mg/m²) with filgrastim. Second mobilization achieved CD34+ peak of 32.6×10⁶ cells/L with 4.73×10⁶ cells/kg collected with minimal morbidity.

pmid-27171670.summary_ja: クリソファノールの絨毛膜癌細胞（JEG-3）に対するアポトーシス誘導作用とシグナル伝達をRNA生成とAKT/ERK1/2経路の制御を通じて調査。シスプラチンとパクリタキセルとの相乗効果を示す。
pmid-27171670.summary_en: Study of chrysophanol (anthraquinone from rhubarb) effects on choriocarcinoma cells (JEG-3, JAR). Chrysophanol induces dose-dependent apoptosis in JEG-3 cells via ROS generation and AKT/ERK1/2 pathway modulation. Demonstrates synergistic effects with conventional agents cisplatin and paclitaxel.

pmid-27188587.summary_ja: 胎児がん細胞と初期胚に含まれるembroglycans（多分岐型ポリN-アセチルラクトサミン）の特性を解析。SSEA-1やLewis x抗原などの多能性幹細胞マーカーを含み、分化に伴い減少。分子量約10,000 Da以上。
pmid-27188587.summary_en: Characterization of embryoglycan, a highly branched poly-N-acetyllactosamine present in embryonal carcinoma cells and early embryos. Embryoglycan carries pluripotent stem cell markers (SSEA-1, Lewis x antigens) and decreases during embryonal carcinoma differentiation and embryogenesis. Molecular weight approximately 10,000 Da or greater.

pmid-27193130.summary_ja: 非上皮性卵巣癌患者57例の後方視的解析で、性索間質性腫瘍33例と胚細胞腫瘍24例を含む。胚細胞腫瘍群は年齢中央値と無病生存期間が低かったが、救援化学療法により3年全生存率90%が得られ、性索間質性腫瘍と同等であった。
pmid-27193130.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 57 non-epithelial ovarian cancer patients: 33 sex cord-stromal tumors and 24 germ cell tumors. GCT cohort had lower median age and initial lower disease-free survival, but salvage chemotherapy achieved 90% 3-year overall survival comparable to sex cord-stromal tumors.

pmid-27229339.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者94例を対象に、CTで計測した乳腺組織径とhCG、組織型、予後との関連を解析した。乳腺組織径が大きいほどlog(hCG)と相関し、遠隔血行性転移とIGCCCG分類の予後不良を予測した。25 mmを超える径は非セミノーマの組織型と関連していた。
pmid-27229339.summary_en: Analysis of 94 testicular GCT patients examining CT-measured breast glandular tissue diameter associations with hCG, histology, and prognosis. Larger breast glandular diameters correlated with log(hCG), predicted distant hematogenous metastases, and predicted worse IGCCCG classification. Diameter >25mm associated with non-seminoma histology.

pmid-27234998.summary_ja: 精巣低リスク非精上皮種生殖細胞腫瘍に対するロボット支援腹膜後リンパ節郭清の多施設研究。47患者中89%がCS I、中央手術時間235分、2年無再発生存率97%で、全員が逆行性射精を保持。
pmid-27234998.summary_en: Multicenter study of 47 patients undergoing primary robotic-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (R-RPLND) for low-stage NSGCT. Median operative time 235 minutes, 89% CS I disease, 17% with positive nodes. Two-year recurrence-free survival 97% with 100% antegrade ejaculation preservation.

pmid-27236469.summary_ja: 70歳男性の原発性肺絨毛膜癌で右上葉切除により成功的に治療された稀な症例。術前のβ-hCG上昇は術後2カ月で正常化し、2年間無再発で経過。適切な外科治療による良好な成績を示す。
pmid-27236469.summary_en: Rare case of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in 70-year-old male successfully treated with right upper lobectomy. Serum β-hCG elevated preoperatively but normalized within 2 months post-surgery. Patient remained disease-free for 2 years, demonstrating favorable outcome with appropriate surgical management.

pmid-27240852.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者65名の認知機能低下と脳灰白質変化を調査。両TC群は対照群より認知機能低下が高率で、化学療法群は前頭前皮質の体積減少と認知機能低下の関連を示した。APOE ε4キャリアでより低下が顕著。
pmid-27240852.summary_en: Study of 65 testicular cancer patients assessing cognitive decline and gray matter changes during chemotherapy treatment. Both TC groups showed higher cognitive decline than controls; chemotherapy recipients exhibited prefrontal reductions associated with worse performance and elevated TNF-α levels.

pmid-27306686.summary_ja: カリフォルニアがん登録の3,961例の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者(1988～2010年)を解析した。治療は後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)(1988年44%から2010年10%)からサーベイランス(35%から61%)へと有意に移行した。サーベイランスが主要な戦略となり、5年全生存率は95%であった。安全性プロファイルに対する認識の変化と治療実践の変化を反映している。
pmid-27306686.summary_en: California Cancer Registry analysis of 3,961 stage I NSGCT patients (1988-2010) showing significant shift in treatment paradigm from RPLND (44% in 1988 to 10% in 2010) to surveillance (35% to 61%). Surveillance became dominant strategy with 95% 5-year overall survival, reflecting improved safety profile perception and changing treatment practice.

pmid-27322711.summary_ja: 20か月齢の小児における尿膜管卵黄嚢腫瘍(性腺外胚細胞腫瘍)の症例。腫瘍の自然破裂により血腹症を来した。腫瘍切除に続いて白金製剤による化学療法を行い、フォローアップ中も良好な経過である。小児の急性腹症では尿膜管胚細胞腫瘍を考慮し、腫瘍マーカーを予防的に測定すべきであることを強調している。
pmid-27322711.summary_en: Case of 20-month-old with urachal yolk sac tumor (extragonadal GCT) presenting with spontaneous rupture causing hemoperitoneum. Tumor resection followed by platinum-based chemotherapy with good follow-up. Emphasizes that urachal GCTs must be considered in acute abdomen presentations in children, with preemptive tumor marker measurement.

pmid-27324054.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍465例の中央病理組織診査により27.7%で診断変更。9%で予後評価変更、6.5%で治療方針変更。セミノーマではrete testis浸潤、非セミノーマではリンパ管侵襲の判定が主な相違点。
pmid-27324054.summary_en: Study of 465 testicular tumor cases reviewed by UK MDT (2004-2012) found pathology altered in 27.7% after central review, with 9% affecting prognostic estimates and 6.5% affecting predicted ESMO guideline-based management. Common discrepancies: rete testis invasion in seminoma, lymphovascular invasion in nonseminoma.

pmid-27351795.summary_ja: 肝転移を伴い、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生する卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を含む胃腺癌の77歳患者の症例。胚細胞腫瘍を標的としたBEP化学療法により部分奏効が得られ、全生存期間は22か月であった。胚細胞成分を伴う胃の混合型腫瘍に対して、胚細胞腫瘍標的薬は「第一選択レジメン」として有効である可能性がある。
pmid-27351795.summary_en: Case of 77-year-old with gastric adenocarcinoma containing yolk sac tumor (endodermal sinus) component producing AFP with liver metastasis. GCT-targeting BEP chemotherapy achieved partial response with 22-month survival. GCT-targeted agents may be effective 'front-line regimen' for mixed gastric tumors with germ cell components.

pmid-27353395.summary_ja: 英国の前向き全国共同研究で、精巣がんに対するRPLND 162例(20名の外科医、17施設)を1年間にわたり検討した。主な適応は化学療法後の残存腫瘤(73%)、再発(14%)、救援療法(7%)、初回治療(6%)であった。完遂率は98%と高く、合併症は10%と少なかった。標本では壊死22%、分化した奇形腫42%、残存腫瘍36%が認められた。
pmid-27353395.summary_en: Prospective UK national collaborative study of 162 RPLND procedures for testicular cancer (162 men, 20 surgeons, 17 centers) over 1-year period. Primary indications: residual mass after chemotherapy (73%), primary treatment (6%), relapse (14%), salvage (7%). High completion rate (98%), low morbidity (10%), with 22% necrosis, 42% teratoma differentiated, 36% residual cancer in specimens.

pmid-27362903.summary_ja: 正常胎盤と絨毛性疾患（全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、絨毛間質腫瘍）におけるPD-L1発現の免疫組織化学的検討。同期栄養膜細胞で高発現し、腫瘍免疫回避に関与する可能性。寛容的な母体-胎児界面形成に関与。
pmid-27362903.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of PD-L1 expression in normal placenta and gestational trophoblastic diseases including complete moles, choriocarcinomas, placental site trophoblastic tumors, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumors. PD-L1 highly expressed in syncytiotrophoblast and may contribute to immune evasion in trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-27384162.summary_ja: 肺塞栓で発症した転移性絨毛癌症例。ECMO支援下に外科的血栓除去術とGCT標的化学療法（BEP）施行。部分奏効・全生存期間22ヶ月。出産適齢女性の肺塞栓では絨毛癌を鑑別診断に含めるべき。
pmid-27384162.summary_en: Case of 22-year-old woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting with pulmonary embolism. ECMO support enabled surgical embolectomy and GCT-targeted chemotherapy (BEP regimen). Partial response achieved with 22-month overall survival. Choriocarcinoma should be considered in differential diagnosis of pulmonary embolism in women of childbearing age.

pmid-27405110.summary_ja: 精巣GCTの分子バイオマーカーのレビュー。化学療法奏効率は高いが約20%は不完全奏効または再発。チロシンキナーゼ、HMGA、Aurora Bキナーゼ、GPR30受容体が予測的バイオマーカーおよび治療標的として注目される。
pmid-27405110.summary_en: Mini-review of molecular biomarkers in testicular GCTs (TGCTs). While majority of TGCTs respond to chemotherapy, approximately 20% show incomplete response or relapse. Recent discoveries include tyrosine kinases, HMGAs, Aurora B kinase, and GPR30 receptor as predictive biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets.

pmid-27409991.summary_ja: SEER 9473例のNSGCT患者における後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）実施率と予後の地域差を分析。都市部・泌尿器科医密度高い地域でRPLND実施率高い。地域性は予後に独立した影響なし。
pmid-27409991.summary_en: SEER analysis of 9,473 NSGCT patients examining impact of urologist density and rural status on RPLND use and cancer-specific death. RPLND performed more frequently in urban counties with higher urologist density. Rurality and low urologist density affected surgical treatment patterns but not cancer-specific mortality.

pmid-27438614.summary_ja: 鼻副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫(SNTCS)の症例報告とレビュー。本疾患は鼻腔および副鼻腔の稀な悪性腫瘍で、成熟および未熟な上皮、間葉、神経外胚葉成分を含む。形態学的な不均一性により誤診がしばしば生じ、再発を伴う予後不良である。治療は外科的切除に続いて放射線療法が行われる。
pmid-27438614.summary_en: Case report and review of sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS), a rare nasal cavity/paranasal sinus malignancy with mature and immature epithelial, mesenchymal, and neuroectodermal components. Morphological heterogeneity causes frequent misdiagnosis; poor prognosis with recurrence. Treatment involves surgical resection followed by radiotherapy.

pmid-27444987.summary_ja: 欧州骨髄移植学会(EBMT)の後方視的解析で、救援大量化学療法を受けた再発純粋セミノーマの男性46例を対象とした。不応性疾患は無増悪生存期間および全生存期間の有意な予後不良因子であった。大量化学療法は標準的な化学療法の失敗後に有用な治療選択肢となりうる。
pmid-27444987.summary_en: EBMT retrospective analysis of 46 male patients with relapsed pure seminoma treated with salvage high-dose chemotherapy. Refractory disease was significant negative prognostic factor for progression-free and overall survival. HDCT may represent valuable option after standard chemotherapy failure.

pmid-27448792.summary_ja: 妊娠陽性と判定された女性に左卵巣大腫瘍を認めた症例。手術で卵巣無性細胞腫（FIGO stage 1A）と確定診断。左卵管卵巣摘出術後、補助化学療法が施行された。
pmid-27448792.summary_en: Case report of 32-year-old woman with positive pregnancy test; imaging revealed large left extrauterine mass. Surgery confirmed ovarian dysgerminoma FIGO stage 1A. Left salpingo-oophorectomy performed with adjuvant chemotherapy planned.

pmid-27449639.summary_ja: 進行GCT患者の3-5%に見られる白金耐性症例の治療戦略レビュー。ゲムシタビン、オキサリプラチン、パクリタキセルが有効で、3剤併用と後腹膜リンパ節郭清で約10-15%が長期生存達成。免疫チェックポイント阻害剤の有効性は検証段階。
pmid-27449639.summary_en: Comprehensive review of treatment options for platinum-refractory male GCTs (3-5% of advanced patients). Gemcitabine, oxaliplatin, and paclitaxel demonstrate activity; triple combination with RPLND achieves 10-15% long-term survival. No molecularly targeted agents show proven efficacy; checkpoint inhibition remains investigational.

pmid-27458149.summary_ja: 25例の混合性胚細胞-性索間質腫瘍（精巣13例、卵巣12例）の組織学的・免疫細胞化学的検討。精巣例の胚細胞は腫瘍性であるが、多くは低悪性度である。一部は管内成分から発生する。卵巣例は組織像がより多様で、ディスジャーミノーマに類似した胚細胞が多く見られた。
pmid-27458149.summary_en: Histological and immunocytochemical examination of 25 mixed germ cell-sex cord stromal tumors (13 testicular, 12 ovarian). Evidence that germ cells are neoplastic; most testicular cases show low-grade germ cells with some arising from intratubular components. Ovarian tumors more diverse, often resembling dysgerminomas.

pmid-27495845.summary_ja: GCT患者166例の血清中マイクロRNA（miR-371a-3p）を検討。従来のAFP、β-hCG、LDH（感度50%）より高感度・高特異度を示し、腫瘍負荷および治療反応との相関を示した。白金系化学療法応答や再発の予測に有用。
pmid-27495845.summary_en: Study evaluates miR-371a-3p as a novel serum biomarker for GCT, achieving 88.7% sensitivity and 93.4% specificity in 166 GCT patients, outperforming traditional markers (AFP, bHCG, LDH combined 50%). Levels correlate with disease activity and treatment response.

pmid-27503429.summary_ja: 精細胞腫瘍の化学療法後残存腫瘤に対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の症例報告。後腹膜残存病変の技術的管理と工夫を提示。
pmid-27503429.summary_en: Case series of robotic-assisted post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for germ cell tumor. Describes robotic approach for challenging post-chemotherapy residual masses, providing technical tips and expanded surgical options.

pmid-27508950.summary_ja: 出生前診断された頭頸部胎児腫瘍の系統的レビュー（306症例）。奇形腫は29.7%を占め、血管腫に次ぐ第2位。診断画像、EXIT手術、生存率35.35%について検討。
pmid-27508950.summary_en: Systematic review of prenatally diagnosed fetal head and neck tumors (306 cases). Teratomas represent 29.7% of cases (second most common after hemangiomas). Reviews diagnostic imaging, prenatal management, EXIT procedures, and postnatal outcomes with 35.35% survival rate.

pmid-27513078.summary_ja: 膣に発生した子宮外胎盤着床部絨毛性腫瘍の症例。扁平上皮がんと誤診されたが、病理と免疫組織化学で診断。化学療法後完全寛解。膣病変の重要な診別診断。
pmid-27513078.summary_en: Case of extrauterine placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) involving the vagina. Initially misdiagnosed as squamous cell carcinoma; PSTT diagnosed by histology, elevated β-hCG, and immunohistochemistry. Complete regression after chemotherapy; important diagnostic differential for vaginal lesions.

pmid-27521765.summary_ja: 仙骨尾骨奇形腫54標本（52患者）の研究。成熟奇形腫はi(12p)陰性、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う腫瘍は陽性。二つの異なる組織発生学的経路を示唆し、予後は良好。
pmid-27521765.summary_en: Study of sacrococcygeal teratomas (54 specimens, 52 patients) demonstrating dual histogenetic pathways. Mature teratomas negative for i(12p); those with yolk sac tumor component positive for i(12p). Excellent long-term prognosis despite rare recurrence.

pmid-27524512.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者561例を対象に、精巣摘除術前のライディッヒ細胞機能不全を検討した研究。hCG陰性患者の25%でホルモン比の異常が認められた。腫瘍径の増大、対側GCNIS、年齢の上昇が機能不全と関連していた。治療後のテストステロン欠乏症への示唆が述べられている。
pmid-27524512.summary_en: Study of preorchiectomy Leydig cell dysfunction in 561 TGCC patients. 25% of hCG-negative patients showed abnormal hormone ratios. Higher tumor size, contralateral GCNIS, and increasing age associated with dysfunction. Implications for testosterone deficiency post-treatment.

pmid-27527805.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣がんの監視療法中の条件付き再発リスク（cRR）を決定した初めての研究。2年間再発がなければ、すべてのリスク群で再発リスクが大幅に低下する。標準的なベースライン因子ではなく、cRRに基づいて個別化した監視プロトコルを支持する結果である。
pmid-27527805.summary_en: First study determining conditional risk of relapse (cRR) during surveillance for clinical stage I testicular cancer. After 2 years without relapse, risk drops dramatically in all risk groups. Supports individualized surveillance protocols based on cRR rather than static baseline risk.

pmid-27549089.summary_ja: 胎盤着床部絨毛性腫瘍の歴史的・臨床的総説。中間栄養膜由来の絨毛性疾患。疫学、病因、管理を解説し、統一されたデータモデルを提案。
pmid-27549089.summary_en: Historical and clinical overview of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a form of gestational trophoblastic disease arising from intermediate trophoblast. Reviews epidemiology, etiopathogenesis, and management; proposes unified PSTT data model for better prognostication.

pmid-27569298.summary_ja: 精巣精細胞腫瘍病理学の総説。層内精細胞腫瘍、i(12p)異常の重要性、胚胎がん、混合腫瘍における奇形腫の位置づけ、精巣と卵巣腫瘍の違いについて解説。
pmid-27569298.summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular GCT pathology. Discusses germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS), isochromosome 12p significance, embryonal carcinoma prevalence, teratoma as terminal differentiation in mixed GCT, and differences between testicular and ovarian tumors.

pmid-27577733.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の根治的精巣摘出術における研修医参加の周術期転帰への影響を検討。研修医参加で手術時間延長が見られたが、合併症増加や有害転帰は認めず。
pmid-27577733.summary_en: Analysis of perioperative outcomes of radical inguinal orchiectomy for testicular cancer with and without resident involvement. Resident involvement associated with prolonged operative time but not increased complications or adverse outcomes.

pmid-27577987.summary_ja: 家族性精巣精細胞腫瘍とPKD1遺伝子新規スプライス変異体の関連を初めて報告。常染色体優性多嚢胞腎疾患を伴うFTGCT患者は2家族目だが、PKD1スプライス変異体は初めての報告。
pmid-27577987.summary_en: Novel association between familial testicular GCT and PKD1 splice variant mutation causing autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease. Second family reported with both FTGCT and ADPKD; first with PKD1 splice variant.

pmid-27584029.summary_ja: 精巣精細胞腫瘍の遺伝子異常と分子生物学的特性についての総説。i(12p)の普遍的な獲得、KIT/KRAS変異、シスプラチン耐性症例でのTP53-MDM2軸異常を解説。治療標的となる可能性のある変異を論述。
pmid-27584029.summary_en: Review of testicular GCT genomics and molecular biology. Highlights frequent chromosomal anomalies, isochromosome 12p, mutations in KIT/KRAS, and alterations in TP53-MDM2 axis in cisplatin-resistant cases. Discusses potential actionable therapeutic targets.

pmid-27593992.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマ病期IIに伴う傍腫瘍性抗NMDA脳炎の症例報告。精神症状を抑うつと誤診されたが、FDG-PET/CTで後腹膜のリンパ節腫大が見つかった。精巣摘除術と化学療法により、症状は完全に消退した。
pmid-27593992.summary_en: Case of paraneoplastic anti-NMDA encephalitis associated with pure seminoma stage II. Presented with neuropsychiatric symptoms misdiagnosed as depression; FDG-PET/CT revealed retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. Orchiectomy and chemotherapy resulted in complete symptom regression.

pmid-27594552.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の寛解後における最適なフォローアップ期間を決定する統計的手法。パラメトリック治癒モデルを用いて再発確率を推定する。不要なフォローアップを減らしつつ、再発の検出を最大化するエビデンスに基づく監視期間を提供する。
pmid-27594552.summary_en: Statistical methodology for determining optimal post-treatment follow-up duration for metastatic NSGCT remission. Applied parametric cure model to estimate relapse probability; provides evidence-based surveillance duration to maximize detection while minimizing unnecessary follow-up.

pmid-27594554.summary_ja: 中間リスクおよび不良リスクの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の予後再分類を検討。全生存に関する4つのリスク因子（原発性縦隔NSGCT、脳転移、肺転移、年齢）を同定した。IGCCCG分類と比較して一致度統計量が改善した。
pmid-27594554.summary_en: Prognostic reclassification of intermediate and poor-risk NSGCT. Identified four risk factors for overall survival: primary mediastinal NSGCT, brain metastases, lung metastases, and age. Improved concordance statistics versus IGCCCG classification.

pmid-27599309.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜精細胞腫瘍患者における精巣微小石灰化の臨床的意義を検討。精巣超音波検査は潜在性原発巣を除外するために重要で、陰性所見は原発巣の可能性を仮想的に除外する。
pmid-27599309.summary_en: Exploration of testicular microlithiasis significance in primary extragonadal GCT. When EGCT suspected, testicular ultrasound essential to exclude occult primary; negative imaging virtually excludes primary lesion. Tumor markers utility with TM remains unclear.
